mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TB_CTR_TNK_RST_IMPROVED ( `DSTRB_ID` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '예측ID', `PRDCT_VALUE` float DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '예측값', `RGSTR_TIME` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '수행 시점', `PRDCT_TIME` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT '예측 시점', `model_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '예측 모델 명', `MODEL_VERSION` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '예측 모델 버전', `n_pumps` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '펌프 대수', PRIMARY KEY (`DSTRB_ID`,`RGSTR_TIME`,`PRDCT_TIME`), KEY `TB_CTR_TNK_RST_IMPROVED_REGSTR_TIME_IDX` (`RGSTR_TIME`,`DSTRB_ID`,`PRDCT_TIME`) USING BTREE, KEY `IX_TNK_RST_IMPROVED_DSTRB_PRDCT_RGSTR` (`DSTRB_ID`,`PRDCT_TIME`,`RGSTR_TIME`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT='배수지및분기결과(시뮬레이터)'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_CTR_TNK_RST_IMPROVED (DSTRB_ID, PRDCT_VALUE, RGSTR_TIME, PRDCT_TIME, model_name, n_pumps) SELECT DSTRB_ID, MAX(PRDCT_VALUE) AS PRDCT_VALUE, RGSTR_TIME, PRDCT_TIME, 'XGBoost' AS model_name, MAX(n_pumps) AS n_pumps FROM TB_CTR_TNK_RST WHERE RGSTR_TIME >= #{fromTs} AND RGSTR_TIME <= #{toTs} AND UPPER(model_name) = 'XGBOOST'
AND DSTRB_ID NOT IN
#{tg}
GROUP BY DSTRB_ID, RGSTR_TIME, PRDCT_TIME ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PRDCT_VALUE = VALUES(PRDCT_VALUE), n_pumps = VALUES(n_pumps), MODEL_VERSION = NULL

INSERT INTO TB_CTR_TNK_RST_IMPROVED (DSTRB_ID, model_name, RGSTR_TIME, PRDCT_TIME, PRDCT_VALUE) VALUES
